methods.name: Rank-revealing least squares: pivoted QR (dqrdc2's limited column pivoting), lm.fit, lm.wfit
methods.reference: base::qr (LAPACK = FALSE, tol 1e-7); stats::lm.fit; stats::lm.wfit; stats::vcov.lm
quantities: lm.wfit coefficients, df, residuals and fitted values with zero weights
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120: coefficients and |diag(R)| 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6 relative; rank, pivot and df exact

methods.name: Symmetric inverse with numerical rank (sym_inverse) and safe_inverse
methods.reference: stats::lm (dummy-trap fit: identified coefficient and RSS reproduced by any generalized inverse of X'X)
quantities: identified x1 coefficient and RSS via the generalized inverse
condition flag of safe_inverse on the dummy trap
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120: coefficient 1e-8, RSS 1e-6 relative; rank exact

methods.name: Generalized linear models by IRLS (glm.fit): gaussian, binomial, poisson, quasi families
methods.reference: stats::glm / glm.fit / summary.glm / logLik.glm (R 4.3.3), epsilon 1e-14 and the default glm.control
quantities: null deviance (incl. the offset + intercept refit)
convergence, separation and scale equivariance (property tests, not R-pinned)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 120: coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6 relative, counts exact; fits at the default epsilon 1e-10 against R at 1e-14: Tol::iterative(1e-8), and Tol::new(1e-5, 1e-12) for the linearly converging probit of fit_glm at the default spec and the fluctuation SE and dispersion (R at epsilon 1e-10 shows the same gap); fit_propensity refines the probit and cloglog coefficients after the deviance rule (relative change below 1e-10) and stops the logit at the deviance rule (Newton, quadratic convergence), so its logit and probit scores and coefficients are at Tol::iterative(1e-8)
